subject: Penetration test packet for procurement gating — Acme Pharma (MAP cutoff)
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@acme-pharma.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acme-pharma.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jan 2028 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: penetration test report and SOC/SIG evidence for MAP gating

Connor —

As we move toward contracting, Procurement at Acme has a MAP gating cutoff of Jan 12 for final security materials. Can you provide the latest penetration test results (we need the executive summary + remediation status) and confirm whether you can complete the SIG/CAIQ evidence set before the cutoff? Our security team is specifically asking for:

- Executive summary (redacted ok)
- High/Medium/Low vuln counts and whether any Criticals were found
- Remediation ETA for open High items
- Any restricted-data handling notes (PII/PHI)

This is a late-stage deal so we need something to attach to contracting this week. If a full redacted report is not possible before Jan 12, will an attestation + remediation matrix suffice for gating?

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Pharma

[Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (xlsx - 12KB)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@acme-pharma.com>
Cc: Red Shield Security <pt@redshield.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jan 2028 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report and SOC/SIG evidence for MAP gating

Elena —

Thanks for the note and the timeline. Short answer: yes, we can meet the MAP gating cutoff with a redacted executive summary + remediation matrix and our SIG/CAIQ checkpoint status. A few details so expectations are aligned:

- We engaged Red Shield Security for our annual pen test (Nov 2027). The full vendor report contains customer-identified data and exploit traces that require limited redaction. Red Shield has agreed to provide a redacted executive summary and a redaction-ready full report.

- Findings (summary): 0 Critical, 2 High, 5 Medium, 7 Low.
  - High items: token-leak on uncommon proxy path (PR/2027-11-H1), insecure TLS config on legacy internal endpoint (PR/2027-11-H2). Both have remediation plans in progress.

- Remediation ETA: we estimate High items closed or mitigated within 14 business days from Jan 4 (target resolution by Jan 20); mitigation steps (WAF rules + config patch + rollout) in place for immediate risk reduction.

Proposed gating deliverables by Jan 9 (to give contracting time before your Jan 12 cutoff):
1) Redacted executive summary (PDF) — suitable for procurement/public sharing.
2) Remediation matrix (spreadsheet) that lists status, owner, ETA, and compensating controls.
3) SIG/CAIQ status snapshot and SOC 2 attestation status note.

We will not release the unredacted vendor file to procurement — we can provide it under NDA to your security team if they request a deep review.

I will circulate the redacted exec summary and remediation matrix once Red Shield confirms the redaction pass (they expect to deliver by EOD Jan 6). If anything slips, I will escalate to Marissa and Laura to buy time with your procurement team.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: acme-pt-request-log.txt (txt - 2KB)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jan 2028 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Acme procurement gating — PT redaction & remediation status

Team — quick internal update and ask. Elena at Acme set MAP cutoff Jan 12; procurement will accept redacted exec summary + remediation matrix for gating. Red Shield says redaction pass complete but they pushed full review until EOD Jan 6.

Current gaps / asks:
- Marissa: can you ok an "attestation + remediation matrix" letter from Legal/Contracts if Red Shield misses their EOD deliverable? That would let us buy an extra 72 hours with procurement.
- Laura: can Security sign off on the compensating controls language for the remediation matrix? Specifically, we need support language for the token leak mitigation (WAF rule + short-lived tokens).
- Rishi: please prepare a short SIG snapshot (1 page) showing SOC 2 status and CAIQ pointers we can attach.

Status summary (from vendor):
- Red Shield deliverable timeline: redacted exec summary (draft) by Jan 6; final redaction + remediation extract by Jan 9.
- Vulnerability counts (vendor): 0 Critical / 2 High / 5 Medium / 7 Low.
- High item remediation: mitigation in place; full root-cause fix targeted by Jan 20.

If Marissa/Laura can confirm the above quick, I'll reply to Elena with the draft attachments and HubSpot links.

Thanks — will ping if vendor slips.
Connor

---
[Internal note: do not share full report without redaction; procurement will not accept the raw vendor file.]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@acme-pharma.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acme-pharma.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Red Shield Security <pt@redshield.io>
Date: Tue, 9 Jan 2028 11:38:00 -0800
Subject: Deliverables: redacted PT executive summary + remediation matrix (for MAP gating)

Elena / Sanjay —

Attached are the deliverables for your procurement packet per the MAP gating request. We are providing what should satisfy contracting for Jan 12: a redacted executive summary, a remediation matrix with owners and ETAs, and a short SIG/SOC2 status note. Links and attachments below.

Attachments included:
- acme-pt-exec-summary-2027-redacted.pdf (executive summary; sensitive traces removed)
- acme-remediation-matrix-2028-01-09.xlsx (status, owners, ETAs; highlights on High items)
- redshield-full-report-2027.pdf (redaction-preview: vendor indicates full copy available to your security team under NDA)

Key points: 
- Findings: 0 Critical / 2 High / 5 Medium / 7 Low (vendor summary).
- High-item status: immediate mitigations applied (WAF rule + TLS config patch staged). Target closure date for both High items: Jan 20 (engineering will update if earlier).
- SOC 2: Redwood is Type II in scope; current testing completed Nov 2027. SIG/CAIQ: snapshot attached — most fields populated; we will provide expanded evidence on request.

If you need the full unredacted vendor report for a security deep-dive, we can make it available to Acme's security team under a targeted NDA — Red Shield will coordinate.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm that the redacted summary + remediation matrix are acceptable for MAP gating.
2) If accepted, let us know how you'd like us to attach these to the contract (HubSpot link or attach directly to procurement email).

Thanks for the partnership — happy to jump on a quick call if your team wants to walk the findings.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: acme-pt-exec-summary-2027-redacted.pdf (pdf - 420KB), acme-remediation-matrix-2028-01-09.xlsx (xlsx - 85KB), redshield-full-report-2027.pdf (pdf - 4.8MB - redaction-preview)]
